objective: server/services/factory/contract.ts narrowsOrEqual (~L779) compares a wildcard-free allowed entry as a bare string prefix: narrowsOrEqual(['client/src/Home.tsx.bak'],['client/src/Home.tsx']) and narrowsOrEqual(['sites/v4-private/**'],['sites/v4']) both return true, so a plan unit can own paths the approved mutation scope never named. Fix: when an allowed entry has no wildcard, require n === a or n.startsWith(a + '/'); keep plain startsWith only for stems cut at a wildcard (e.g. 'src/' from 'src/**'). Keep the '**' shortcut and the absolute/.. refusal. Existing tests (tests/factory.test.ts, tests/factoryExecutionPlane.test.ts, tests/russellSoftwareJourney.test.ts, factoryFindingsClosed, factoryBulkTick using exact 'src.txt') use glob stems or exact files and must keep passing.
expectedOutcome: An owned path is inside the approved scope only across a path boundary.

acceptanceConditions.statement: narrowsOrEqual refuses sibling-prefix paths, with a test that fails before the fix

rollbackRequirement: Revert the commit; no schema or data change.
